name: Shop Availability Per Airport
query:
SELECT
    airport AS "Airport:Link/Airport:200",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status='Available' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Available Shops:Int:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status='Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Occupied Shops:Int:150",
    COUNT(name) AS "Total Shops:Int:120"
FROM `tabShop At Airport`
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY airport;
